name: canchaya-backend
description: Backend para el Sistema de Reserva de Canchas - CanchaYA

scripts.transpile:frontend: node -e "const ts = require('typescript'); const fs = require('fs'); const jsx = fs.readFileSync('../canchaya-frontend/js/app.js', 'utf8'); const res = ts.transpileModule(jsx, { compilerOptions: { jsx: ts.JsxEmit.React, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020 } }); fs.writeFileSync('../canchaya-frontend/js/app.compiled.js', res.outputText);"
